name: Nextcloud
tagline: A self-hosted cloud drive that grows into a workspace
description: File sync and sharing with a web interface, desktop sync clients and mobile apps. Optional apps add calendars, contacts, tasks, notes, chat and video (Talk) and browser-based office editing, all behind one login.
backing: Nextcloud GmbH (Germany), funded by enterprise subscriptions rather than venture capital

maturity.rationale: The default answer for self-hosted files for a decade, with a large app ecosystem and many hosting providers. Major upgrades still deserve a backup and a quiet afternoon.

selfHosting.summary: All-in-One (AIO) gets a complete instance with backups and office editing running from a single Docker command. The work is in what follows: staying on supported upgrade paths, tuning background jobs, and keeping it fast as apps accumulate.

requirements.notes: Add 2 GB or more if the office editor and Talk run on the same machine. Storage is whatever your files need, plus room for versions and the trash bin.

managedHosting.label: Providers listed by Nextcloud
managedHosting.note: Free and paid accounts from independent hosts in many countries

managedHosting.label: Hetzner Storage Share
managedHosting.note: Managed Nextcloud instances hosted in Germany and Finland

strengths: One login covers files, calendars, contacts, tasks, notes, chat and video
Mature desktop and mobile clients, with automatic photo upload on phones
Plenty of managed hosts if you would rather not run it yourself
Open standards throughout: WebDAV, CalDAV and CardDAV
weaknesses: A PHP application that turns slow when under-provisioned or overloaded with apps
Major versions cannot be skipped when upgrading, and third-party apps occasionally break
Sync is reliable for documents but slower than Dropbox or Seafile on huge trees of small files
End-to-end encryption exists but is limited and awkward; most installs rely on server-side encryption

featureNotes.on-demand-files: Windows and macOS clients; not Linux
featureNotes.browser-editing: With Nextcloud Office (Collabora) or another editor connected
